name: Prometheus Alertmanager
description: Authenticated Alertmanager webhook receiver with firing/recovery normalization; no vendor API access required. Uses native manual device-to-branch mapping.

configFields.label: Webhook receiver token
configFields.help: At least 32 unpredictable characters. Set as X-Plugin-Signature in Alertmanager http_config.http_headers. Devices appear in the native mapper after their first accepted observation.
